summary: Appointment to assistant teacher posts in West Bengal; eligibility under West Bengal Primary School Teachers Recruitment Rules, 2016; minimum qualification under Rule 6(2) as per NCTE notification dated 29.07.2011; impact of COVID-19 on D.El.Ed. 2020-2022 batch; delay in examinations and results; Calcutta High Court intervention for timely declaration of results; undertaking to allow TET-qualified candidates provisionally in recruitment; validity of such inclusion upheld; recruitment notification dated 21.10.2022; ad-hoc measures by Government and Board post-24.08.2022; interim directions by High Court on 29.09.2022 allowing participation of pending candidates; no prejudice to final outcome; appeal concerning fairness and legality of recruitment process; issue of age bar and procedural compliance.
legal_provisions_cited: West Bengal Primary School Teachers Recruitment Rules, 2016, Rule 6
National Council for Teacher Education Act, 1993
Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009, s.23
Article 226 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Leave granted; matter remanded for appropriate consideration of the appellants' eligibility in the recruitment process without prejudice to final determination; interim status maintained.
